title: Your Policy Is Secretly a Harness: The Decision Geometry of Agent Interfaces
abstract: arXiv:2610.37255v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language model agents are post-trained and deployed through a harness, the prompts, tools, and control logic that present a task to the model and execute its outputs. Harnesses are often revised and judged by how an already trained model performs under them, which assumes that what the model learned under one harness carries over to the next. We ask what a policy learns from its harness and what survives when the harness changes. Under KL-regularized control, we show that the log odds of an optimal policy recover how strongly its harness favors each action over the others, so a trained policy carries the preferences of its harness. Deployed return then equals the ceiling of the harness, the best return it offers, minus the mismatch of the policy, the return lost to its own suboptimal decisions. translated_title: 你的策略其实就是一个框架：智能体界面的决策几何学
translated_abstract: 语言模型智能体是通过一个“框架”进行后训练和部署的，即向模型呈现任务并执行其输出的提示词、工具和控制逻辑。框架经常被修改，并以一个已训练模型在其下的表现为依据来评判，这隐含地假设了模型在一个框架下学到的东西能够迁移到下一个框架。我们追问：策略究竟从它的框架中学到了什么，而当框架改变时又有什么能够留存？在 KL 正则化控制下，我们证明最优策略的对数几率恢复了其框架对每个动作相对于其他动作的偏好强度，因此训练后的策略承载了其框架的偏好。部署回报等于框架的上限——它能提供的最佳回报——减去策略的失配——由策略自身次优决策而损失的回报。训练只改变失配项，而更换框架则会同时改变两项。因此，用固定的模型来比较不同框架会把各自的……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 该论文证明：训练后的语言模型策略会继承其框架的动作偏好，部署回报可分解为框架上限与策略失配之差——训练只改变失配项，而更换框架会同时改变两者，因此模型性能无法在不同框架间想当然地迁移。
en_tdlr: A trained policy secretly inherits its harness's action preferences: deployed return equals the harness's ceiling minus the policy's mismatch, so training only changes the mismatch while swapping harnesses changes both—undermining the assumption that performance transfers across harnesses.
